units: meters, FIBA half court. World origin = rim center projected on the floor, +x toward the baseline, +y up, +z toward the camera

logic.note: oneOnOne.js runs in 2D pixels: x along the court, y = height above the floor. These map them to meters

camera.note: 2K-style: behind the ball handler, facing the hoop. drive* apply inside driveRadius of the rim or on a dunk
